source_evidence: Player exact direction as in pending packet. Actual chosen selected-run occurrence fixed before dice, then directly observable cargo and monetary exchanges, group stealth success on actual recorded RNG. No covert approach to private premises or new criminal guilt established; optional local investigation remains independent of resolved murder verdict. D326~16:35 public towpath outside first of the two fixed privately leased riverside storehouses, Orsaven. V/Cirren/Fenar together in ordinary public foot traffic; Mara accepted V's request to return to Copper Hart, safely returned during ordinary city walk, remains there with coach/four horses, not participating in surveillance. Exact player: 'Mara you should go back to the inn... we will be back soon. Everyone else, lets follow the money quietly'. Authorizes discreet observation and ordinary public shadowing, not boarding, purchase, trespass, magic, seizure, violence or promises. Actual 16:00 selected evening ferry departure and illicit transfer fixed before dice as local DM adjudication consistent with prepared selected-run operation, not a recovered historical schedule; ~16:10 visible transfer at assessment landing. Cirren observed lamp operator from public steps25ft above; V/Fenar observed from public lower landing/fenders, allowing complementary sightlines without invented face recognition. Saw a patched-sail lighter alongside ferry, cases moved across plank, a man awaiting lower steps received cases, and a discreet purse passed from that man to the landing official after the lamp signal; contents/value/purpose not directly established. Passengers departed normally, no intervention, injury, alert, boat hire or cargo seizure. Rejoined and followed receiving merchant/cases on ordinary public towpath to storehouse1, staying unnoticed with actual group Stealth DC14 (V19+11=30, Cirren advantage7/8+2=10, Fenar18+5=23; 2/3 succeeds). Saw cases admitted through storehouse1's south public-towpath-facing loading door; receiver passes coin purse to a man with account book, who writes a document at loading bay. No reading, receipt custody, identities, verified bribe amount, proof of murders or illicit provenance beyond coxswain testimony and actual observations. Party outside on public path, no trespass. DM-only retained fixed setup: storehouse1 60x40ft, two20ft loading bays, rear10ft office, south loading doors/north uphill street exit, 10ft landing; storehouse2 150ft along towpath, upper meeting room 200ft uphill. Existing finite roster/initial allocation remains; only visible workers/keeper and two armed escorts at entrance, not automatically hostile; no meeting/attack/clock or further inference. Source dm-ferry-setup.md @300789a66801d87700502e1499b9cfbb15ff72b4, dm-ferry-ii.md @5b3e57c906b5e7bf90c45c870c42e320aaa01afa. D326 paymaster48gp held, restitution authority notification promised not confirmed, no funds recovered. Purse2049gp8sp6cp rations21/feed28 LR0/6, surveillance not rest, no spending. Other commitments unchanged: royal decision pending, Kestrel confidential copies complete originals retained; frontier commission300+1300 contingent; western conditional service-house grant not deed, Coris300 pending optional800, magic orders balance520 target353, Elara Caereth Severin assent unconfirmed.
